hero.intro_en: Your team is launching eco-friendly office supplies for small businesses. Write a short brand message that defines the audience, communicates the value, and uses a clear, professional voice. Then use what you learned for your own personal brand line.
hero.intro_es: Tu equipo va a lanzar suministros de oficina ecológicos para pequeñas empresas. Escribe un mensaje de marca breve que defina el público, comunique el valor y use una voz clara y profesional. Luego usa lo que aprendiste para tu propia frase de marca personal.

hint.en: One line that captures the idea.
hint.es: Una línea que resuma la idea.

parts.example: Good for your budget. Good for the planet.
phrases: Good for your [benefit]. Good for the [benefit].

hint.en: Who exactly the product is for.
hint.es: Para quién es exactamente el producto.

parts.example: …is made for small businesses with 5 to 50 employees…
phrases: [Product] is made for [audience] who want to [goal].

hint.es: Qué le preocupa hoy a tu cliente.

parts.example: Many owners want to reduce waste, but think green products cost too much.
phrases: We know that [problem] is a real challenge for [audience].

hint.en: Eco-friendly + cost savings, in plain words.

parts.example: …cost the same as standard brands, and our refills help you buy less.
phrases: [Product] costs the same as [alternative], and [extra benefit].

hint.en: A fact that proves your promise.
hint.es: Un dato que demuestre tu promesa.

parts.example: Every order ships in recycled packaging…

hint.en: Tell the reader what to do next.
hint.es: Dile al lector qué hacer después.

parts.example: Switch your next order to LeafLine…
phrases: Try [product] today and see the difference.

rules.t_es: Claro y enfocado en el cliente
rules.d_en: Talk to “you”, the customer. Short sentences.
rules.d_es: Háblale a “you”, el cliente. Oraciones cortas.

rules.d_en: Professional and positive from start to end.
rules.d_es: Profesional y positiva de principio a fin.

rules.d_en: No emojis, no “best in the world”, no invented numbers.
rules.d_es: Sin emojis, sin “el mejor del mundo”, sin números inventados.

example.subject: Brand message – LeafLine Office Supplies
paragraphs: Good for your budget. Good for the planet.
LeafLine Office Supplies is made for small businesses with 5 to 50 employees that want a greener office without paying more.
Many owners we talk to want to reduce waste, but they believe eco-friendly products are always too expensive for a small team.
Our recycled paper, refillable pens and plant-based cleaning products cost the same as standard brands, and our refill system means you buy less over time.
Every order ships in recycled packaging, and a simple online dashboard shows how much you save each month, in dollars and in waste.
Switch your next order to LeafLine today and see the difference in your costs, and in your office, in your first three months.

original.goal: Practice clarity, consistency, and customer focus by crafting a short brand message.
original.title: Creating a Brand Message
original.body_en:
✍️ Writing Task

Title: Creating a Brand Message
Time: 1–2 hours

Scenario:
You are part of a team launching a new product. The product is eco-friendly office supplies designed for small businesses.

Your Task: Write a short brand message (120–150 words) that:

Defines the target audience.

Communicates the value proposition (eco-friendly + cost savings).

Uses a clear, professional brand voice.

Why This Matters:
Crafting a brand message helps you practice clarity, consistency, and customer focus—the same skills U.S. companies expect across departments.
original.body_es:
✍️ Tarea de Escritura

Título: Creando un Mensaje de Marca
Tiempo: 1–2 horas

Escenario:
Eres parte de un equipo que está lanzando un nuevo producto. El producto son suministros de oficina ecológicos diseñados para pequeñas empresas.

Tu Tarea: Escribe un breve mensaje de marca (120–150 palabras) que:

Defina el público objetivo.

Comunique la propuesta de valor (ecológico + ahorro de costos).

Utilice un tono de marca claro y profesional.

Por Qué Esto Importa:
Crear un mensaje de marca te ayuda a practicar la claridad, la consistencia y el enfoque en el cliente, las mismas habilidades que las empresas de EE. UU. esperan en todos los departamentos.
original.goal_es: Practicar la claridad, la consistencia y el enfoque en el cliente creando un breve mensaje de marca.
